title: Codex, Sandboxes, and Exact Simulator Destinations
summary: Dom Esposito documents recurring Codex failures where sandboxed GitHub CLI and CoreSimulator access are misdiagnosed as missing authentication or unavailable devices. His repository instructions force explicit host-access decisions and an exact simulator destination discovered from xcodebuild.
takeaway: Record the exact simulator-discovery command and known sandbox failure signatures in AGENTS.md. Grant host access narrowly for the affected build or test command, not as a blanket default.
